## Highlights

- OSC 7501 revision 0.4 query replies with accepted state and kind names.
- Extensible report names through distinct borrowed string types.
- One program-status capability accessor for support and accepted names.

Both `uncurses` and `uncurses-ratatui` use version `0.0.7`.
The adapter has no independent API changes in this release.

## Migrate from v0.0.6

This release changes the program-status API introduced in v0.0.6.

### Query replies and capabilities

Replace `Event::ProgramStatusSupported` with `Event::ProgramStatus(report)`.
The `event::ProgramStatusCapabilities` payload owns two public lists:
`report.states` and `report.kinds`.

`Capabilities::program_status()` returns `Option<&ProgramStatusCapabilities>`
instead of `bool`. Use `.is_some()` for a support check.
Use the returned payload to read accepted names.

`None` means support remains unconfirmed. A reply confirms support even
when both lists are empty. Absent reply fields use the fixed protocol
defaults. Explicit empty lists stay empty, and extension names remain intact.

### Report state and kind names

`ProgramStatusState<'a>` and `ProgramStatusKind<'a>` are borrowed string
types with associated constants. Replace the former enum variants:

| v0.0.6 | v0.0.7 |
|---|---|
| `ProgramStatusState::Idle` | `ProgramStatusState::IDLE` |
| `ProgramStatusState::Working` | `ProgramStatusState::WORKING` |
| `ProgramStatusState::Done` | `ProgramStatusState::DONE` |
| `ProgramStatusState::Blocked` | `ProgramStatusState::BLOCKED` |
| `ProgramStatusState::Error` | `ProgramStatusState::ERROR` |
| `ProgramStatusState::Clear` | `ProgramStatusState::CLEAR` |
| `ProgramStatusKind::Permission` | `ProgramStatusKind::PERMISSION` |
| `ProgramStatusKind::Question` | `ProgramStatusKind::QUESTION` |
| `ProgramStatusKind::Auth` | `ProgramStatusKind::AUTH` |

Use `new(name)` for extension names and `as_str()` to read their wire values.
Add a lifetime parameter where stored state or kind types require one.
Use a fallback arm in matches to handle extension names.
Equal names compare and hash equally, whether constructed or supplied by a constant.

Constructors borrow names. The writer validates them before output.
Names must be nonempty and use the protocol's value alphabet.
The complete encoded report must fit within 4096 bytes.
Commas are valid report bytes, but query replies interpret them as list separators.
Check terminal support before you use an extension.

## Unchanged behavior

Program reports still flush immediately. Queries remain optional and explicit.
The terminal owns record lifetime; pause, resume, and finish leave records intact.

The `program_status` example demonstrates queries and extension names.
Its four standard report sequences remain unchanged.
Its output adds an escaped custom-name preview line.

See the [program status guide](https://uncurses.org/docs/guides/program-status/)
and [protocol specification](https://www.superlogical.com/rex/docs/build/program-status).
